description: Reproducible synthetic shelf test pairs for computer vision evaluation and agent verification

cases.name: Nominal / Identical Planogram
cases.description: Identical product arrangement with realistic sensor noise. Tests false-positive suppression.

cases.name: Confirmed Shelf Vacancies (Out of Stock)
cases.description: Two distinct products removed (Tea/Soy slot and Tonic slot). Tests structural void detection.

cases.name: Rigid Camera Displacement & Slight Tilt
cases.description: 12px horizontal translation and 0.6 degree tilt. Tests ECC planar alignment recovery.

cases.name: Ambiguous Specular Glare & Displaced Item
cases.description: Heavy diagonal lighting reflection and slightly shifted item. Tests agentic escalation to human review.
